source: Omen inventory extracted verbatim from core/Currency/*.java (via currencies.json). `impl` maps each omen to the packages/engine function + option that realises it; `verified:true` = implemented AND covered by a dedicated per-omen unit test (omens.test.ts) plus, where Java models it, a differential test. Audit the catalog vs poe2db at the 0.5 refresh.

omens.note: Exalt adds a prefix only (ExaltAndRegalProbability.NormalCompute, prefixes-only). Differential-green via AddAffixProbe.
Exalt adds a suffix only. Differential-green via AddAffixProbe.

Adds an extra modifier (2 total) — a MULTI-affix transformation, not a single-add probability. Java returns 0 (unimplemented). Belongs to the sequence/optimizer layer (P(both mods) = compound of two draws); no single-step engine fn yet.
Annul removes a prefix only (1/prefixes). Differential-green via AnnulProbe.
Annul removes a suffix only (1/suffixes). Differential-green via AnnulProbe.
Removes a desecrated mod with certainty on a desecrated item (else 0). Hand-tested; audit exact scope vs poe2db 0.5.
Perfect essence removes only a prefix (1/prefixes). Differential-green via EssenceProbe.
Perfect essence removes only a suffix (1/suffixes). Differential-green via EssenceProbe.
Default desecration restricted to a suffix (combined normal ∪ desecrated suffix pool). No Java counterpart (D4 in validation.md); hand-tested.
Default desecration restricted to a prefix (combined normal ∪ desecrated prefix pool). No Java counterpart (D4); hand-tested.
Desecration forced to Kurgal's pool: 1/(count of kurgal desecrated mods of the slot). Count-uniform (D3). Differential-green via DesecrationProbe.
Desecration forced to Amanamu's pool: 1/(count of amanamu desecrated mods of the slot). Differential-green via DesecrationProbe.
Desecration forced to Ulaman's pool: 1/(count of ulaman desecrated mods of the slot). Differential-green via DesecrationProbe.
